answer_1.quote: To address our research questions, we suggest the following approach. First, given a set of input utterances, generate several sarcastic responses. ... We built three surveys, labelled (a)-(c), that we published on the Prolific Academic crowdsourcing platform, ... participants evaluated each response across four dimensions: (1) Sarcasm, (2) Humour, (3) Coherence, (4) Specificity.
datasets: Twitter action corpus (short texts describing actions)

answer_4.quote: We built three surveys, labelled (a)-(c), that we published on the Prolific Academic crowdsourcing platform... In the survey, we asked participants to evaluate each response across four dimensions: Sarcasm, Humour, Coherence, Specificity, and to select their preferred response and judge the appropriateness of responding sarcastically.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated each generated response on Sarcasm, Humour, Coherence, Specificity (0‑4 scales) and indicated preferred response and appropriateness of sarcasm.
